newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT - Umaga to play in Wellington club final.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT - Umaga to play in Wellington club final.

text.p: WELLINGTON, July 30 - All Black wing Tana Umaga will play for Petone against Marist-St Pat's in the Wellington club rugby final on Sunday, NZPA reports.
Umaga, who suffered a rib injury in the tri-series test win over South Africa in Johannesburg 10 days ago, was given the green light to play by All Black coach John Hart last night.
"I was nearly right for the test in Melbourne but didn't want to go into a test where the guys were under so much pressure when I wasn't right," he said.
Petone co-coach Allan Hewson said Umaga would partner Wellington Hurricanes team-mate Jason O'Halloran in the centres, with Karl Tenana, recovering from a groin injury, on the wing.
"I was at Petone training and was asked if I was able to play. So I thought I might as well ring up to find out and was told it would be a good idea to play," Umaga said.
"I'm definitely looking forward to it. It will be a big game. The only disappointment will be that I am putting out someone in the backline who has been filling the spot all season."

Umaga said he knew nothing of rumours that he was being targeted by the Auckland Warriors. Australian newspapers reported that the Warriors were keen to cash in on the league experience Umaga had in his youth.
But Umaga said he was not interested in playing for the Warriors and was enjoying playing for the All Blacks.
"It is still hard to believe sometimes, when you realise it is a dream come true."
